name: juftin/camply
what_it_holds: Python CLI/TUI (651 stars, MIT, actively maintained, 257 commits) that polls Recreation.gov, ReserveCalifornia, Yellowstone Lodges, and GoingToCamp-platform state park systems for campsite cancellations/availability at sold-out campgrounds and pushes notifications (email/Slack/SMS/Telegram/webhook). No bundled historical data; it is a live-polling method.
why_useful: Outdoor-recreation booking pace is a competing-travel-dollar signal and a clean analogue for the RNPL/cancellation-monitoring thesis (watching for cancellations at capacity-constrained inventory) — same mechanic as the STR cancellation/lead-time question (gap #3), just on a different asset class; also a template for point-in-time capacity-utilization capture.

name: usdot-jpo-codehub/rec-gov-analysis
what_it_holds: US DOT Volpe Center tooling (not a live scraper of Airbnb) for analyzing recreation.gov's own historical reservation exports from the RIDB portal (ridb.recreation.gov data-download page) across national forests/federal campgrounds, built for transportation-planning demand analysis. No data committed; points to a real point-in-time reservation-history download.
why_useful: Outdoor-recreation/camping booking curves are a public, government-hosted 'book-ahead' kernel analogue (like NCLH advance sales, item 18) with real reservation lead times and cancellation behavior; a cross-check on how far ahead US leisure travelers commit, useful context for the RNPL/booking-lead-time thesis and travel-volume seasonality even though it never touches Airbnb.

name: vincentarelbundock/WDI

name: Kayak-Scraper (flight data library)
what_it_holds: 9-star Python scraping library that pulls flight search results (route, date, price, airline) directly from kayak.com; no data committed, method only.
why_useful: A maintained (updated 2026-04-30) general-purpose Kayak flight-data puller; same rationale as the flight-price-prediction repo for gap 10 travel-demand proxies, but purely a method with no stored data and scraping Kayak is outside sanctioned sources — flag only, do not run.
